name: Griffon Open
where: St. Joseph, MO · host Missouri Western · MWSU Cross Country Course
headline: Griffon Open
summary: Final: Southwest Baptist's Natalie Gerdes won the women's 5K in 17:10.6, 39 seconds clear of the field. Rogers State's Thomas Kubala won the men's 8K in 25:30.1, ahead of Pittsburg State freshman Zach Anderson (25:34.9) and Rogers State's Jack Morgan (25:37.8).
